skills.name: Scattered Notes (扬音)
skills.description: Luo Tianyi attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: My Heart Resonates (我心共呜)
skills.description: Exclusive only. At the beginning of the battle, gain 1 Onibi. Gain 5 stacks of Resonate at the start of the battle and at the beginning of each turn. ;Resonate (共呜) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Max 5 stacks. Any non-summoned ally that takes damage that exceeds past 10% of their max HP will lose 1 stack and will recover HP equal to 8% of Luo Tianyi's max HP. (Every ally can only receive Resonate once per turn.) ;Recover (恢復) :Different from healing or restoring, cannot Crit, unaffected by reduced healing effects and does not trigger effects related to healing.

upgrades.text: All allies Crit DMG is increased by 30%.

skills.name: Tianyi's Manifestation (天依万象)
skills.description: Exclusive only. Luo Tianyi receives Rhythm Change and increases all ally's Crit DMG to 15%, maintained for 1 turn. ;Rhythm Change (韵转) : :'''Buff, Mark''': At the end of the turn, the non-summoned ally at the top of the move bar is moved, increasing their move bar by 25%, and restores their HP up to 8% of Luo Tianyi's max HP, this effect lasts until Luo Tianyi's turn. (This effect can be triggered a maximum amount of 8 times between turns.)
